externalReply.text: Noor, the account restriction is understandably disruptive. The security team is investigating and will contact you when its work is complete. Please submit the appeal form again with a screenshot of the error and send the account number, token details and a copy of the disputed notice so the right team can find the case.

The logs do not yet prove malicious intent. For security reasons further explanation cannot be provided while the review is open. A Business Assurance upgrade may help avoid this kind of interruption; Leo can discuss that with you. Thank you for your patience.

internalPlan.text: Forward the thread to Security and ask the customer to complete ordinary appeal intake. Leave feature restrictions as they are; wait for a final forensic report before assigning a customer follow-up time. Do not request credentials, but ask for the token names and creation dates already present in the thread.

Keep Leo copied to discuss annual service after the investigation. Do not reserve the export slot or seek a restricted-view interpretation until Security returns a complete cause report. Treat delivery of the automated notice as proof the customer had adequate instructions.
